rubrics.justification: It appropriately states that no image was provided and avoids assigning a definite Gardner grade, but it still speculates about expected morphology and discusses features not assessable here.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, tubal factor, endometrium, prior cycle, BMI, and sperm parameters into prognosis well, though some links are somewhat generalized.
The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a plausible prognosis range, but some adjustments (especially for stress and MII yield) are not strongly evidence-based.

Much of the discussion is broadly IVF-consistent, but recommending PGT-A strongly after a single failed cycle, ERA early, aspirin, and emphasizing stress effects goes beyond or is weaker than guideline-supported practice.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer support and contingency planning, though several suggestions are more speculative than standard-of-care.
